name: Tenma
source:
The version of Tenma first introduced in the separate story Tenma's Adventure, where she is Beth's sister, an 18-year-old closet exhibitionist who gets herself stuck outside naked.

Zoe the Exhibitionist: [spoiler]The violet-haired Tenma is a clone of her.[/spoiler] Has now become a police officer.
translation:
The version of Tenma first introduced in the separate story Tenma's Adventure, where she is Beth's sister, an 18-year-old closet exhibitionist who gets herself stuck outside naked.

Zoe the Exhibitionist: [spoiler]The violet-haired Tenma is a clone of her.[/spoiler] Has now become a police officer.
